trailhead.label: The mini-golf in Schenna, the board’s start

cautions: Most of the loop is on quiet tarred lanes and farm access roads shared with cars and tractors: lead on and keep to the side.
Short crossings of St.-Georgener-Straße in Schenna: lead short.
Orchards, vineyards and meadows beside the lanes are farmed and closed to dogs in Schenna in the growing season: keep to the lane.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
